title: Android Integrations
meta: We connect billing, analytics, email tools and your own backend to your Android app, tested in your accounts. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Android integrations for billing, analytics and your backend
overview: We connect your app to the services behind your business: Play Billing, analytics, push or email providers and your own API. We read the provider's docs, create keys in your accounts, write the code in a separate module and test with sandbox and real data. You receive working flows and plain notes on how each piece is configured.

list: Keys set up in your own accounts

pkgs.blurb: Up to three services, with tested flows and offline handling.
A complete integration set with billing, push and backend sync.

faq: Play Billing, Firebase, Stripe for physical goods, Mixpanel, Klaviyo, OneSignal and any REST API are common. If a provider has an Android SDK or a clear API, we can usually connect it.
Can I take card payments for subscriptions with Stripe?

Google Play requires Play Billing for digital content and in-app features in most cases. Stripe suits physical goods and services. We follow Google's payments policy and tell you which route fits your product.
Do you need my provider logins?
No. You create the accounts, or we guide you, and add us with limited permissions. Provider fees and keys stay with you, and we never ask you to share a password.
What if my backend lacks documentation?
Send what exists and we inspect the requests ourselves, then write down what we found and confirm it with you. Large backend changes are a separate job.
